scripts.text: A great stone gate stands before you. The sculpture of a terrible dragon spreads its powerful looking wings.
scripts.translation: 一座巨大的石門矗立在你面前，門上雕刻著一條可怕的巨龍，展開強健的雙翼。

scripts.text: Near the bottom of the gate, Laphine tribeswomen have been turned to stone and now look like they are part of the great door.
scripts.translation: 石門底部有幾位被石化的拉菲尼族女子，看起來已與巨門融為一體。

scripts.text: Move closer to look more carefully.
scripts.translation: 走近仔細看看

scripts.text: Step back.
scripts.translation: 退後一步

scripts.text: A mysterious power prevents you from getting too close. It looks like there is something strong beyond the door...
scripts.translation: 神秘的力量阻止你靠近，門後似乎藏著某個強大的存在...

scripts.text: Perhaps there's a great hidden secret beyond the gate, beyond expectation.
scripts.translation: 也許門後藏著超乎想像的秘密。

scripts.text: It would be better to go back to camp and inform the others and ask for help.
scripts.translation: 還是回營地，把情況告訴其他人，尋求幫助吧。

scripts.text: You'll have to obtain the others trust in the expendition camp by working hard.
scripts.translation: 你得在遠征營地努力做事，贏得其他人的信任。

scripts.text: A mysterious power prevents you from getting too close. It looks like there is something strong beyond the door...
scripts.translation: 神秘的力量阻止你靠近，門後似乎藏著某個強大的存在...

scripts.text: Perhaps there's a great hidden secret beyond the gate, beyond expectation.
scripts.translation: 也許門後藏著超乎想像的秘密。

scripts.text: It would be better to go back to camp and inform the others and ask for help.
scripts.translation: 還是回營地，把情況告訴其他人，尋求幫助吧。

scripts.text: You'll have to obtain the others trust in the expendition camp by working hard.
scripts.translation: 你得在遠征營地努力做事，贏得其他人的信任。

scripts.text: The strange sensation surrounding your body has disappeared
scripts.translation: 籠罩全身的奇異感覺消失了。

scripts.text: When you touch the stone gate, you hear a commanding voice.
scripts.translation: 觸控石門時，你聽到了威嚴的聲音。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Wingless one... Our promised words...
scripts.translation:
[??????]
無翼者... 我們約定的話語...

scripts.text: 'Guardian's spell'!
scripts.translation: 守護者的咒語

scripts.text: Take a step back.
scripts.translation: 退後一步

scripts.text:
[??????]
Promised words... Guardian's spell... proof of their existence.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
約定的話語... 守護者的咒語... 他們存在的證明。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
In the name of Yggdrasiliad, I will accept you as a servant of the Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
以世界樹之名，我接納你成為守護者的僕從。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
I accept your entrance through the Guardian's gate. You are now considered a faithful servant of the Guardian Nidhoggur.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
准許你通過守護者之門。
從此，你便是守護者尼德霍格忠實的僕從。

scripts.text: The voice has disappeared, and the dark power is calming down from behind the stone gate.
scripts.translation: 聲音消失了，石門後的黑暗力量也漸漸平息。

scripts.text: As I put my hands on the stone gate, a voice sounded from the depth of my heart.
scripts.translation: 你把手放在石門上，一個聲音從心底深處響起。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
Where are the other servants, so you can work together? Each servant cannot be admitted here individually...
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
其他僕從呢？你們必須共同行動，不能獨自進入...

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
Come with at least 1 more servant... Only party leaders can accept admission to Nidhoggur's Nest.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
至少再帶一名僕從來...
只有隊長能申請進入尼德霍格巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
And only 1 representative of you needs to talk to me, so don't annoy me...
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
派一位代表來與我交談就夠了，別來煩我...

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
The loyal servants of the Guardian... what can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
守護者的忠實僕從... 有何請求？

scripts.text: Please allow me to enter.
scripts.translation: 請准許進入

scripts.text: I want to go in.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: I want to leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
The Guardian seems to wish to be alone. I will go in and check, please wait out here.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
守護者似乎想獨處。
我進去看看，你們在外面等候。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
I've recorded your request, are you ready to go inside?
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
請求已記錄，準備好進去了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
If you are ready, I will allow you to enter.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
準備好了，我就准許你們進入。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
If you have the dungeon generated already, you can enter it.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
地下城建立完成後即可進入。

scripts.text: I want to go in.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: I want to leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
With the defeat of Nidhoggur's Shadow, the roots of the World Tree Yggdrasil are also affected.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
尼德霍格的影子被擊敗後，天地樹的根部也受到了影響。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
After Nidhoggur's Shadow disappears, at least 3 days is needed for stabilizing.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
尼德霍格的影子消失後，至少需要三天才能恢復穩定。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
If you have the dungeon generated already, you can enter it.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
地下城建立完成後即可進入。

scripts.text: I want to go in.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: I want to leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
The time limit to enter the dungeon has expired. You must wait for the World Tree to stabilize its power before trying to re-enter.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
入場期限已過，必須等天地樹的力量恢復穩定，才能再次進入。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
The World Tree Yggdrasil has stabilized. Would you like to enter Nidhoggur's Nest again?
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
天地樹已經恢復穩定。
要再次進入尼德霍格巢穴嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
If you would like to enter again, please register with me.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
想再次進入，請向我登記。

scripts.text: A great stone gate stands before you. The sculpture of a terrible dragon spreads its powerful looking wings.
scripts.translation: 一座巨大的石門矗立在你面前，門上雕刻著一條可怕的巨龍，展開強健的雙翼。

scripts.text: Near the bottom of the gate, Laphine tribeswomen have been turned to stone and now look like they are part of the great door.
scripts.translation: 石門底部有幾位被石化的拉菲尼族女子，看起來已與巨門融為一體。

scripts.text: Move closer to look more carefully.
scripts.translation: 走近仔細看看

scripts.text: Step back.
scripts.translation: 退後一步

scripts.text: A mysterious power prevents you from getting too close. It looks like there is something strong beyond the door...
scripts.translation: 神秘的力量阻止你靠近，門後似乎藏著某個強大的存在...

scripts.text: Perhaps there's a great hidden secret beyond the gate, beyond expectation.
scripts.translation: 也許門後藏著超乎想像的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
發生了未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
You didn't ask to be admitted... You should accept admission first before entering.
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
你還沒有申請入場...
先取得許可，再進去。

scripts.text:
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
Where are the other servants, so you can work together? Each servant cannot be admitted here individually...
scripts.translation:
[世界樹守門人]
其他僕從呢？你們必須共同行動，不能獨自進入...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
Sure, the mainland also has lots of interesting adventures... Hello, I am Magnifier, a historian dispatched from the Prontera royal court.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
當然，大陸上也有不少有趣的冒險...
你好，我是普隆德拉王室派來的歷史學家馬格尼弗。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
Does Commander Agip want to talk to me? Let's listen to his story.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
阿吉普指揮官想找我談談？
那就聽聽他怎麼說吧。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
Why are you standing there? Go to my assistant in the Prontera Library!
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
你站在那裡幹什麼？去普隆德拉圖書館找我的助手！

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
You've come back... Good, how's Naomi? Actually, I don't need to worry about her. She is always cheerful. Haha.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
回來了啊... 娜奧米怎麼樣？
其實不用擔心她，她總是那麼開朗。
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
Okay, let's try to contact them first, to be clear about any caves or treasures.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
好，先試著聯絡他們，把洞穴和寶藏的情況弄清楚。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
Ah, you've come at a proper time. I found a curious thing while looking for reports from Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
啊，來得正好。
我查詢阿魯納菲茲的報告時，發現了一件有趣的事。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
Report to Commander Hibba Agip about what we have discovered, since time is dependent on his decision.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
把我們的發現報告給希巴·阿吉普指揮官吧，接下來的安排得由他決定。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
So that's how it is... we were right about some parts of it... it's called the Guardian's Nest.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
原來如此... 有些地方我們猜對了...
那是守護者的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
Finding another line of work might make for a really worthy job, but only a historian gets to know the world over..
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
別的工作或許也很有價值，可只有歷史學家才能縱觀整個世界...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
How this world is organized... and the way of the future! With our studies of the past and present we can predict what is to come.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
世界如何構成... 未來又將走向何方！
研究過去與現在，就能推測將來。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
We are expecting a lot from you, expert adventurer. So, if you find anything... just tell me.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
你是經驗豐富的冒險者，我們對你寄予厚望。
有什麼發現... 一定告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magniffer]
Did you find the cave that the fairy tribes treat as a holy place? You are a really tough cookie. What did you find?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
你找到了妖精族視為聖地的洞穴？
真有你的！發現了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Wait a second... I have a brilliant idea.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
等一下... 我想到一個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Let's see... This book... No... this one...? Hmm... Maybe this...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
讓我看看... 這本... 不對... 這本？
嗯... 也許是這本...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
... ...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
... ...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Oh, here it is! World Tree Yggdrasil and God's tribes... This is their book!
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
哦，找到了！天地樹與神族...
這本書講的就是他們！

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Maybe you found the central line to enter into the World Tree Yggdrasil!
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
你找到的，或許就是通往天地樹的主要通道！

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
If that's true, you've found the greatest discovery since the harnessing of mana. Isn't this exciting?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
若真如此，這可是人類學會運用魔力以來最偉大的發現！
想想就激動，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
But we need a lot more information... Are they refusing you admission?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
不過，還需要更多資料...
他們不讓你進去？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
I will send a message to my assistant who is in the Prontera Library. So, help her find more information.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
我會捎信給普隆德拉圖書館的助手。
你去幫她查詢更多資料吧。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
I will definitely help you find a way to enter the World Tree directly so, just believe in me! Okay~!!
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
相信我，一定能幫你找到直接進入天地樹的方法！
放心吧~

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
You look like you have a lot on your mind... Your face is full of curiosity and questions.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
看你若有所思的樣子... 滿臉都是好奇和疑問。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
So, did you read the whole story that I have prepared?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
我準備的那些故事，你都讀完了嗎？

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒讀完

scripts.text: I read all the stories.
scripts.translation: 全都讀完了

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Sheesh~ I prepared these stories for you carefully, but you didn't bother to check anything out did you?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
哎呀~ 我精心為你準備了這些故事，結果你根本沒看，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
It would be better if you returned after reading all of them. That's very basic data of what we should do for the future.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
讀完再來吧，這些都是今後行動所需的基礎資料。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Hm, good job. Maybe I don't need to check anything else, right?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
嗯，做得不錯。看來我不需要再檢查其他東西了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
I sent you to figure out which basic materials will be needed for the jobs ahead of us. You should bring research reports...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
讓你調查，是為了弄清今後工作需要哪些基礎資料。
你應該把研究報告帶回來...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
You might complain about why I didn't bring any myself... That's because I trust your abilities, don't ever take anything for granted.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
你或許會問，為什麼我不自己去找...
那是因為相信你的能力，可別把這份信任當作理所當然。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
But a while ago, while you were tranferring reports from Commander Agip to the mainland, you lost those reports... remember?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
不過，上次替阿吉普指揮官把報告送回大陸時，你把報告弄丟了... 記得吧？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
So far, nothing's come up... Was it that somebody attacked you?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
到現在也沒什麼線索...
當時有人襲擊你？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Somehow, the truth will come out, but we should be careful of shocking the natives if we go there unannounced and they're not prepared for our arrival.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
真相總會查明的。
不過，不能不打招呼就貿然前往，免得當地人毫無準備，受到驚嚇。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
I've talked too much... Anyway, as you know through my report, you've found a great thing!
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
說得太多了...
總之，讀過我的報告，你也該知道這發現有多重要！

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Firstly, we should find out more about the place. I expect we can, but... we can't do much without help from others.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
首先，得進一步瞭解那裡。
應該能查清楚，不過... 僅靠我們，能做的很有限。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
I have heard about recent expeditions of adventurers that have tried to contact the tribes... Have you heard anything about this?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
聽說最近有冒險者嘗試接觸那些部族...
你知道什麼訊息嗎？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Anyway, let's try to contact them first, to be clear about any caves or treasures.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
總之，先試著聯絡他們，把洞穴和寶藏的情況弄清楚。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
For now, you try to contact the Sapha and Laphine tribes, and try to extract information from them.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
先去聯絡薩法族和拉菲尼族，看看能打聽到什麼。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
I'll also keep searching here. If you find anything, come back and let me know.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
我也會繼續查詢資料。
有發現就回來告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
For now, you try to contact the Sapha and Laphine tribes, and try to extract more information.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
先去聯絡薩法族和拉菲尼族，設法打聽更多訊息。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
I'll also keep searching here. If you find anything, come back and let me know.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
我也會繼續查詢資料。
有發現就回來告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Right now, we are standing on part of one of the roots of the World Tree Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
我們此刻站著的地方，其實是天地樹的一條樹根。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
This spot is connected to World Tree by the root. I think we can expect confrontations between the Sapha and Laphine here eventually, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
這裡通過樹根與天地樹相連。
我想，薩法族和拉菲尼族遲早會在這裡發生衝突，你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
As I expected, the cave is the entrance to go to one of Yggdrasil's roots...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
果然，這個洞穴就是通往天地樹一條樹根的入口...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Did you find anything about the Sapha and Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
打聽到薩法族和拉菲尼族的訊息了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Both sides act ambiguously, so... I'm getting worried...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
雙方態度都不明朗... 真讓人擔心...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
The two tribes have some trouble amongst their top leaders. It's not anything official, but...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
兩族高層之間似乎有些矛盾。
雖然還沒有正式訊息，不過...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Let's report to Commander Agip about the situation so far. Then, we wait on his decision.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
先向阿吉普指揮官彙報目前的情況，等他決定吧。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
We have gained a large amount of knowledge today, but...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
今天我們得知了不少事情，不過...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
What we have figured out... how is it going to influence mankind? It's so unpredictable...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
這些發現... 會給人類帶來什麼影響？
實在難以預料...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
This is only the beginning...we will be quite busy from now on.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
這才剛開始... 今後有得忙了。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
First, report to Commander Agip, then act according to the situation. Let me organize my research findings...
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
先向阿吉普指揮官彙報，再視情況行動。
我來整理研究結果...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
Finding another line of work might make for a really worthy job, but only a historian gets to know the world over..
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
別的工作或許也很有價值，可只有歷史學家才能縱觀整個世界...

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
How this world is organized... and the way of the future! With our studies of the past and present we can predict what is to come.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
世界如何構成... 未來又將走向何方！
研究過去與現在，就能推測將來。

scripts.text:
[Historian Magnifier]
We are expecting a lot from you, expert adventurer. So, if you find anything... just tell me.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家 馬格尼弗]
你是經驗豐富的冒險者，我們對你寄予厚望。
有什麼發現... 一定告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
The doctor never ever tries to come back, and there're too many things to do... How can I do it all...
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
博士就是不肯回來，事情又堆了一大堆...
我一個人怎麼做得完...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Browse around, to take a look at the books.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
四處看看，翻翻書。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Hey, you. Please move these books. Put them into shelf 3 row B.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
喂，你，幫忙搬一下這些書，放到 3 號書架 B 排。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Don't you see I am too busy? Don't hesitate. Just do it.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
沒看見我忙得不可開交嗎？
別磨蹭了，快動手。

scripts.text: Look busy, and take a step back.
scripts.translation: 假裝忙碌，往後退一步

scripts.text: Help her just this once.
scripts.translation: 這次就幫幫她吧

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Gosh! Where is-? Where did-? Ugh! It's so difficult!
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
天哪！在哪兒...？放哪兒了...？
唉！真難找！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Ah... if you're done moving those, then these should go in shelf 3 row B.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
啊... 那些搬完了，就把這些放到 3 號書架 B 排。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Now, I am almost done... Who are you? Are you a new assistant to Dr. Magnifier?
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
好了，差不多忙完了...
你是誰？馬格尼弗博士的新助手？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He asked me to bring some reports. Didn't he say anything?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他讓我來取一些報告。
他沒告訴你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Hmm... I haven't seen him in over a year! What's he doing now?
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
嗯... 我都一年多沒見過他了！
他現在在忙什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He said that he would send a message to you... didn't you get it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他說會捎信給你... 沒收到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Message? ...Let's see... I never expected him to write a message...
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
信？... 我找找...
沒想到他還會寫信來...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
I will check the mailbox, wait a minute. If you get bored read those books.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
我去看看信箱，稍等。
無聊的話，就翻翻那些書吧。

scripts.text: It's too messy due to lots of stacked books and files. Dr. Magnifier looks like he has a ton of reports.
scripts.translation:
書籍和檔案堆得到處都是，顯得十分凌亂。
馬格尼弗博士似乎積累了大量報告。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'Birth of the World', 'The Fiction of Odin's Myth', 'God's Battle Then After', 'Dreams of the Tribes'. There are a variety of books...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
《世界的誕生》、《奧丁神話的虛構》、《諸神之戰之後》、《部落之夢》。書種類真多...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Oh, sorry I took so long. There was too much mail, so it took me a while to find stuff.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
哦，抱歉讓你久等了。
信太多，找起來費了些時間。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
He has sent me mail over 20 times. I did not know that...
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
他居然寫了二十多封信，我都不知道...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Ah, here's the message about you. He's said to share the information on research and reports.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
啊，這封提到了你。
他說要與你分享研究資料和報告。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is the Doctor's area of expertise?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
博士主要研究什麼？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Ever since 5 years ago, he has been curious about how the world started, and so he began his search for the God of creation.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
從五年前起，他就對世界的起源產生了興趣，開始尋找創世之神。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
He researches combat between Odin and the Gods, and about the Gods' origins and life.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
他研究奧丁與諸神的戰爭，以及諸神的起源和生平。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, did he already know that the Rebirth of Satan Morocc has occurred before?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這麼說，他以前就知道魔王夢羅克曾經復活過？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
I can't be sure, but he thought someday it would occur. It broke out earlier than he expected though.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
不敢確定，不過他認為遲早會發生。
只是實際發生得比預料的早。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But Rune-Midgarts approved this research?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是盧恩·米德加茲批准了這項研究？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Our academics are not a religion. And they too have curiosity about this world's history.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
我們做的是學術研究，不是宗教活動。
王國也想了解這個世界的歷史。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
The combat of Odin vs. the Gods, and the God's sons and their purpose... The Doctor has researched this his whole life.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
奧丁與諸神的戰爭、神之子，以及他們的目的...
博士一生都在研究這些。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But those reports haven't come out yet. Have they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是那些報告還沒有公開吧？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
That's why he sent you here. By the way, this isn't the first time I've heard this.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
所以他才讓你過來。
其實，這些事情我以前也聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
After the establishment of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom and Arunafeltz, the rumors have spread in secret about their tribes, myths, etc.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
盧恩·米德加茲王國和阿魯納菲茲建立後，關於各族與神話的傳聞，就一直在暗中流傳。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Anyway, I should make sure that you read all these books, and I'll just keep doing my work.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
總之，這些書你都得讀完。
我繼續忙我的事了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shouldn't I have filed the books?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道我不應該整理這些書嗎？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
The Doctor said he will pick up the books through another person. Besides, don't you need the basic information on what to do?
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
博士說會派別人來取書。
而且，你不也得先了解情況，才知道該做什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Before you go back to the Doctor, you had better read these books. So, I will go back to work.
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
回去見博士前，先把這些書讀完吧。
我去忙了。

scripts.text: Discovery of Heterogeneity
scripts.translation: 異質性的發現

scripts.text: Report of Indigenous Tribes
scripts.translation: 原住民部落報告

scripts.text: Satan Morocc has known that he didn't resurrect normally or by himself.
scripts.translation: 魔王夢羅克知道，自己並非正常復活，也不是自行復活的。

scripts.text: Continuously, adventurers from Rune-Midgarts have attacked him and he is slowly losing his power. He would need more time to resurrect completely.
scripts.translation:
盧恩·米德加茲的冒險者不斷進攻，魔王夢羅克的力量逐漸衰弱。
他還需要更多時間，才能完全復活。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc stopped to destroy the city of Morocc, turning it into a ruined desert, then started to rip the world apart.
scripts.translation: 魔王夢羅克將夢羅克城毀成一片荒漠後，轉而開始撕裂世界。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc was worried about those who would give chase, so he created Morocc clones to keep watch behind him.
scripts.translation: 為防有人追擊，魔王夢羅剋制造了分身，留在身後警戒。

scripts.text: Modeled after Morocc, their appearance made it difficult to go around the time-space gap.
scripts.translation: 這些分身以魔王夢羅克為原型，阻礙人們接近時空裂縫。

scripts.text: Still the adventurers gave chase. They came from all over the world, trying to approach the Dimensional Gorge.
scripts.translation:
冒險者們仍然窮追不捨。
他們從世界各地趕來，試圖接近次元峽谷。

scripts.text: The reports of these adventurers have been sent to representatives of all kingdoms, and an expedition team has been created to find out more information.
scripts.translation:
冒險者的報告送到了各國代表手中。
隨後，各國組建了遠征隊，進一步調查。

scripts.text: The scientists of Schwarzwald created a combination metal, using fragments of metals found in the dimensional gorge.
scripts.translation: 修瓦魯茲巴魯德的科學家利用在次元峽谷中發現的金屬碎片，創造了一種合金。

scripts.text: The Schwarzwald Republic requested approval to find the source of the new metal, and since Rune-Midgarts couldn't complete the test themselves, they finally accepted.
scripts.translation:
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國申請調查新金屬的來源。
盧恩·米德加茲無法獨自完成試驗，最終同意了。

scripts.text: They associated together to gather volunteers. The Assassin Guild was the first to volunteer.
scripts.translation: 雙方聯合招募志願者，刺客公會率先響應。

scripts.text: The Assassins have a terrible past with Satan Morocc, so they gathered 18 members to chase him down.
scripts.translation: 刺客們與魔王夢羅克有著慘痛的過往，因此集結了 18 名成員展開追擊。

scripts.text: About 3 hours later, all 18 members returned without any problem, and each man and woman shared the information that they had collected.
scripts.translation: 大約三小時後，18 名成員全部平安歸來，各自彙報了收集到的情報。

scripts.text: They had discovered another world with a definitively different nature and environment. And indeed, people could also live there.
scripts.translation: 他們發現了一個自然環境截然不同的世界，而且人類也能在那裡生存。

scripts.text: The most surprising thing is the flow of time. The 18 assassins had stayed for about 2 weeks in there, yet they returned within 3 hours after departing.
scripts.translation:
最驚人的是時間流速。
18 名刺客在那裡待了約兩週，回來時，這邊卻只過了三小時。

scripts.text: The last thing to be tested... was to send adventurers who volunteered to explore the new world.
scripts.translation: 最後的測試... 是派遣自願參加的冒險者，探索新世界。

scripts.text: There was a flood of adventurer applications. Lots of volunteers disappeared over the dimensional gorge, and they brought back new data.
scripts.translation:
冒險者的申請紛至沓來。
許多志願者穿過次元峽谷，帶回了新的資料。

scripts.text: The new world could support 3 completely different eco-systems dependant upon the race of people that lived there.
scripts.translation: 新世界存在三種截然不同的生態環境，與當地居民的種族相對應。

scripts.text: The heterogenous phenomenon needed to be studied thoroughly and carefully in order to under the relationship between thair world and ours.
scripts.translation: 要弄清新世界與我們世界的聯絡，必須對這些異常現象進行深入、謹慎的研究。

scripts.text: Just when it was expected to be impossible to travel into a different world, the first page of a new chapter was opened.
scripts.translation: 正當人們以為無法前往異世界時，一段新歷史揭開了序幕。

scripts.text: Long ago, there wasn't a sun, moon, or stars; just empty earth... and Ymir was born. Then, by making sons, Ymir grew.
scripts.translation:
很久以前，沒有日月星辰，只有空曠的大地... 尤彌爾在此誕生。
隨著子嗣繁衍，他的族群逐漸壯大。

scripts.text: But, his sons grew as well and he was killed by Odin, Vili, and Ve; 3 brothers, Gods, that attacked from different sides.
scripts.translation:
他的子嗣也逐漸成長。
後來，奧丁、維利和韋三位神明兄弟從不同方向進攻，殺死了尤彌爾。

scripts.text: At that time of Ymir's fall his blood flooded the world... killing all in it's path.
scripts.translation: 尤彌爾倒下時，鮮血淹沒世界... 所到之處，生靈盡滅。

scripts.text: Only Hvergelmir of the Sapha tribe escaped from this flooding of blood. And he swore vengeance in Jotunheim, which is covered with foggy snow.
scripts.translation:
只有薩法族的赫瓦格密爾逃過了這場血海。
他在風雪迷濛的約頓海姆立誓復仇。

scripts.text: Currently, one of the Sapha tribe has been discovered from beyond the Dimensional Gorge.
scripts.translation: 如今，次元峽谷的另一側已發現薩法族的成員。

scripts.text: Other than the Sapha tribe, there was another tribe beyond the time-space gap, known as the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 除了薩法族，時空裂隙另一側還有一個部族，叫拉菲尼族。

scripts.text: The Laphine tribes gathered as well for an expedition to explore the time-space gap and figure out the World Tree's strange symptoms and perharps a cure method.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族也組織了遠征隊，探索時空裂隙，調查天地樹的異常，並尋找治癒的方法。

scripts.text: The Laphine tribe was charged with the management of Yggdrasil, to establish their lands close to Asgard, and to protect the balance of Yggdrasil's magic power.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族受命管理天地樹，在阿斯加德附近建立領地，維護天地樹的魔力平衡。

scripts.text: The Laphine tribe has never contacted anyone outside of Asgard. But since they found that Yggdrasil's power if weakening...
scripts.translation:
拉菲尼族從未與阿斯加德以外的人接觸。
然而，他們發現天地樹的力量正在衰弱...

scripts.text: They have declared they will attend to the high courts for the first time in 1000 human years, since the end of the battles of Gods vs. Magicians.
scripts.translation: 他們宣佈，自諸神與魔法師之戰結束一千年後，將首次出席最高議會。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Naomi]
Don't you see that I'm too busy? Don't dawdle, just go!
scripts.translation:
[助手 娜奧米]
你沒看到我正忙嗎？別磨蹭了，快走吧！

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
Nowadays, the world has turned unstable. I can't even fly comfortably anymore.
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
現在世界越來越不安穩，連飛都飛不舒坦了。

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
SeLarsmar Di marThusVil U SeMushVohl
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
SeLarsmar Di marThusVil U SeMushVohl

scripts.text: What's with the cave up north?
scripts.translation: 北邊洞穴是怎麼回事

scripts.text: Who are the Sapha tribesmen?
scripts.translation: 薩法族是什麼人

scripts.text: Hmm. We can talk later.
scripts.translation: 改天再聊

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
What? If you wander around there... you might return with injuries.
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
什麼？在那邊亂逛... 小心帶著一身傷回來。

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
I don't know exactly how to explain it, but it's like it has a bad mood. There are lots of terrible monsters there.
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
說不上來，就是氣氛不對勁。
那裡有不少可怕的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
They whisper to each other, so... something is there... But I don't care...
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
它們總在竊竊私語... 肯定藏著什麼...
不過我才懶得管...

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
Might be... those Sapha tribesmen have dug in the cave before... They do have a special talent for digging.
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
也許... 薩法族以前在那個洞裡挖過...
他們倒真是擅長挖洞。

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
Oh! It is because of them that we have been living here, a lowdown and dirty city, for over one hundred years.
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
哼！全怪他們，我們才在這破爛骯髒的城裡住了一百多年。

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
They don't care if there's trouble with the Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
天地樹出了問題，他們根本不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
They are surely full of bad ideas, so... they have destroyed the Yggdrasil's root.
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
他們滿肚子壞水... 天地樹的根肯定就是他們破壞的。

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
We are here to make sure that the Sapha don't make things worse.
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
我們待在這裡，就是防著薩法族把事情弄得更糟。

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
Nowadays, the world has turned unstable. I can't even fly comfortably anymore.
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
現在世界越來越不安穩，連飛都飛不舒坦了。

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
What can you expect when Manuk giants start to dig into the world to destroy the Yggdrasil...
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
馬努克那些巨人挖來挖去，破壞天地樹... 還能指望什麼...

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
And the worst thing is... that strange things are strutting along the streets of the towns...
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
最糟的是... 城裡居然還有怪東西在街上大搖大擺地走...

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
Yes, you... What do you think about the way the government is handling this...?
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
對，就是說你...
你覺得政府這麼處理合適嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Grumbling Soldier]
Although they ignore your track record, still, one should be careful...
scripts.translation:
[牢騷滿腹計程車兵]
就算他們不計較你的來歷，還是小心點吧...

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
When will we be finished with this combat with the Sapha? Ugghhhh...
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
跟薩法族的仗，到底什麼時候才打完？
唉...

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
VohlLarsmar Ha DielCyatas
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
VohlLarsmar Ha DielCyatas

scripts.text: What's with the cave up north?
scripts.translation: 北邊洞穴是怎麼回事

scripts.text: Who are the Sapha tribesmen?
scripts.translation: 薩法族是什麼人

scripts.text: Hmm. We can talk later.
scripts.translation: 改天再聊

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
Well... I'm not sure, but we have avoided going to that area.
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
嗯... 我也不清楚，我們一直不去那一帶。

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
Sometimes, the dispatched researchers hang around here... I feel bad that there's nothing to see... without any reason...
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
有時派來的研究員會在這附近轉悠...
可什麼也找不到，看著都替他們難受...

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
But the command officers make sure that there's something hidden in there.
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
不過，指揮官們認定那裡藏著什麼。

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
We don't know if the monsters there are strong, so we never checked it out. But on a personal level, nobody wants to go there...
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
不知道那裡的魔物有多強，所以沒去查探。
說實話，誰也不想去...

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
I don't know what others think about it... but we've had some trouble with our attitude against the Sapha tribes.
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
不知道別人怎麼想... 但我覺得，我們對薩法族的態度確實有問題。

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
We didn't try to solve the problems with talk. We attacked them first.
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
我們沒試著坐下來談，是我們先動手的。

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
Maybe... our command officers don't want to accept other species different than us...
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
也許... 指揮官們根本不願接納與我們不同的種族...

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
Don't misunderstand... Recently, we have talked about your particular species and our commanders feel grateful to you.
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
別誤會... 最近我們也談到你們這一族，指揮官們還是很感激你們的。

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
Anyway... I'm just exhausted during this useless and nerve-wracking situation... Sigh.
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
總之... 這種毫無意義、又讓人提心吊膽的局面，真是累死人...
唉。

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
When will we be finished with this combat with the Sapha? Ugghhhh...
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
跟薩法族的仗，到底什麼時候才打完？
唉...

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
Frankly, I don't think of you or any Sapha is our enemy. Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
說實話，我不覺得你和薩法族是我們的敵人。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Sighing Soldier]
Is there no way to resolve this by communicating? There's no meaning in useless combat! Geez.
scripts.translation:
[嘆氣計程車兵]
難道不能好好談談來解決嗎？
打這種無謂的仗有什麼意義！真是的。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Are you...? Are you the one collecting information from my soldiers...?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
你是...？就是你在向我計程車兵打聽情報...？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
If you can't follow this rule, I will stop associating with you and ban all of your people from here.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
不遵守這條規矩，我就中止與你們的往來，禁止你們這一族踏入這裡。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Why have you come back, outsider?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
外鄉人，你為什麼又回來了？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Outsider. Arioss here will explain the situation with the giants, talk with him...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
外來者，阿利奧斯會向你說明巨人的情況，去找他談吧...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Welcome to the Laphine camp in Splendide, outsider... I am Lebiordirr. I am in charge here.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
歡迎來到輝煌領域的拉菲尼營地，外來者...
我是萊比奧迪爾，這裡的負責人。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
I was waiting for you. You came back safe, that's good news. Did you find anything?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
一直在等你。
平安回來就好，有什麼發現？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Strange one, thank you for your cooperation in such situations... Please forget what has happened today...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
外來者，謝謝你的配合...
今天發生的事，請忘掉吧...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
You should be cautious. Our tribe has respected the existence of you humans but...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
謹慎些。
我族一直尊重你們人類，不過...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
I've taken a great risk in allowing you in here. So be wary.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
准許你進入這裡，我冒了很大的風險。
行事小心些。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Don't attract too much attention because that would make your people look bad.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
別太招搖，免得損害你們人類的形象。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Now, we don't need to talk much about this, so just go back where you came from.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
這件事我們不必多談，請原路返回吧。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Unless you have any messages for me...? Your face says you do...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
還是說... 有話要告訴我？
看你的表情，似乎還有事...

scripts.text: No. Nothing. We can talk later.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼，改天再談

scripts.text: I intend to stay. For good reasons.
scripts.translation: 我有理由留下

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Sir, I can drag this pest out right now.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
長官，我這就把這個討厭的傢伙拖出去。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
No. Let's hear an explanation. Good? Now, if you want...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
不，先聽聽解釋。
好，說吧...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
I have known that, recently, time has broken... so, you're here exploring for a solution, no?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
我知道最近時空出現了紊亂...
你是來尋找解決辦法的吧？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Our tribe has respected you, so just forget about the searching and exploring around here.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
我族尊重你們，不過，還是別在這裡四處搜尋探查了。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
I heard that you are to search for any treasure in the closed cave to the north.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
聽說你想去北邊封閉的洞穴尋寶。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
That place is banned by order of the Laphine tribe. So, people can't just go there without permission.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
那裡是拉菲尼族明令禁止進入的地方，未經許可，不得擅入。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
If you can't follow this rule, I will stop associating with you and ban all of your people from here.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
不遵守這條規矩，我就中止與你們的往來，禁止你們這一族踏入這裡。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
We still have an unstable relationship with the Sapha, we usually don't worry about outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
與薩法族的關係仍不穩定，我們通常無暇顧及外來者。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Now, if you understand this, inform your friends.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
既然你明白了，請轉告你的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
We still have an unstable relationship with the Sapha, we usually don't worry about outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
與薩法族的關係仍不穩定，我們通常無暇顧及外來者。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Now, if you understand this, inform your friends.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
既然你明白了，請轉告你的同伴。

scripts.text: To ask the Laphines about exploring...
scripts.translation: 向拉菲尼族詢問探索事宜...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Exploring what? Choose your words wisely?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
探索什麼？說話謹慎些。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Do we not understand each other? What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
我說得還不夠清楚嗎？
你到底想做什麼？

scripts.text: I must explore the cave.
scripts.translation: 我必須調查洞穴

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
That means... that you are ignoring my warning? Is this your decision or are you just following orders?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
這麼說... 你要無視我的警告？
這是你自己的決定，還是奉命行事？

scripts.text: I'm just following orders
scripts.translation: 我只是在執行命令

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Are you trying to insult me on purpose, outsider?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
你是在故意侮辱我嗎，外來者？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Why do you want to explore? It better be a very good reason.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
為什麼非要調查？最好有個充分的理由。

scripts.text: It's about Dr. Magnifier's report...
scripts.translation: 關於馬格尼弗博士的報告...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
So... What do I care about an outsider's report?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
外來者的報告... 與我何干？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
To protect the Yggdrasil! That's the Laphine's fate. Can you say that about yourself?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
守護天地樹，是拉菲尼族的宿命！
你也能說自己肩負這份使命嗎？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Do you have any proof of your birth with Odin and Yggdrasil's blessings?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
你能證明自己是受奧丁與天地樹的祝福而生的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
I shouldn't say anymore. Please don't take this as being rude but, please go now!
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
不必再說了。
別怪我無禮，請立刻離開！

scripts.text: Then I'll ask the Sapha for help.
scripts.translation: 那就請薩法族幫忙

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
What are you talking about, outsider?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
你在說什麼胡話，外來者？

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Sir, I can get rid of this rude outsider if you wish?
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
長官，要不要我把這個無禮的外來者趕出去？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
No, wait... The Sapha tribesmen know the meaning of that place? Did you ask to associate with them?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
不，等等... 薩法族知道那地方的意義？
你已經請求他們合作了？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Ah... How tricky... Are you testing us?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
啊... 真狡猾... 你在試探我們？

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Calm down, sir. I will throw this outsider into prison.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
冷靜點，長官。我會把這個外來者關進監獄。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
No... No, wait. Ok, I will accept it. I can accept your admission into the Holy Sekos.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
不... 等等。
好，我同意，准許你進入神聖塞科斯。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Okay. If you are a servant of the Yggdrasil as you claim to be, I will allow you admission. But I am not responsible for your actions.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
若真如你所說，是天地樹的僕從，我就准許你進入。
不過，你的行為由你自己負責。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
And make sure that if you find anything out of the ordinary in there, that you share it with us!
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
還有，裡面若有任何異常發現，必須告訴我們！

scripts.text: But of course!
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
So... since I have agreed to allow your exploration... Arioss, help them, and take the results.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
既然准許了調查... 阿利奧斯，協助他們，收集調查結果。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Sir... are you sure? This is an invasion of the Holy Sekos...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
長官... 您確定嗎？
這可是侵犯神聖塞科斯...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Invasion is a harsh word. I am allowing them entrance. Better them than a dirty giant. It might just save our lives...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
“侵犯”說得太重了，我准許他們進入。
總比讓那些骯髒的巨人進去好，或許還能救我們...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Here, outsider. Arioss will explain the situation with the giants. Talk with him...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
外來者，阿利奧斯會向你說明巨人的情況。
去找他談吧...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Be cautious of your actions. We already have lots of problems with the Sapha tribe as it is.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
行事謹慎些，我們與薩法族之間的麻煩已經夠多了。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
If you are cautious with your actions, I won't place any harm on you. Fare well.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
只要謹慎行事，我就不會傷害你。
保重。

scripts.text: Explain about the guardian Nidhoggur's leave.
scripts.translation: 說明守護者尼德霍格失蹤的事

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
What? The Guardian is not in his nest...?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
什麼？守護者不在巢穴裡...？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
And because of his disppearance, the Guardian's Shadow is currently destorying the roots of the World Tree...?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
因為他失蹤了，守護者的影子正在破壞天地樹的根...？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
That's unbelievable. You must be insulting the Guardian's and our pride. I did not provide you with our help for that.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
這簡直難以置信。你這是在侮辱守護者和我們的尊嚴。我提供協助可不是為了讓你說這種話的。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
It's not like that, Commander, they speak the truth.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
指揮官，並非如此，他們說的是實話。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
What are you saying? Arioss, do not forget your place as the Guardian's priest.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
你說什麼？阿利奧斯，別忘了你身為守護者祭司的職責。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Even though I have not seen it with my own eyes, this does explain why we lost communication with the great World Tree Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
雖然尚未親眼證實，卻能解釋為什麼我們與偉大的天地樹失去了聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Do not speak of His Highness, the World Tree Yggdrasil's name so lightly.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
不要如此輕率地提及天地樹陛下之名。

scripts.text: Pass along World Tree Yggdrasil's words.
scripts.translation: 傳達天地樹的話

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
His Highness, the World Tree Yggdrasil, said that?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
天地樹陛下真是這樣說的？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
The reason behind all of this... is not because of the Sapha tribe, but because of the sudden leave of the Guardian? And the Guardian has given up on his identity?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
這一切... 不是薩法族造成的，而是因為守護者突然離去？
他還放棄了自己的身份？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
This must be reported... reported to the High Priest of Alfheim... Unbelievable.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
必須上報... 向阿爾弗雷姆的大祭司報告...
難以置信。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Commander... do we need to alert the rest of the tribe...?
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
指揮官... 要通知族內其他人嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
You don't need to worry about this, Arioss. As commander, I will handle it. You just pretend nothing happened...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
阿利奧斯，這件事不必你操心，我會處理。
你就當什麼也沒發生...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Strange one, thank you for your cooperation in such situations... Please forget what has happened today...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
外來者，謝謝你的配合...
今天發生的事，請忘掉吧...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Arioss, please compensate this strange one for the help. I need to go rest...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
阿利奧斯，替我酬謝這位外來者。
我得去休息了...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Commander...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
指揮官...

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Be cautious of your actions. We already have lots of problems with the Sapha tribe as it is.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
行事謹慎些，我們與薩法族之間的麻煩已經夠多了。

scripts.text:
[Commander Lebiordirr]
If you are cautious with your actions, I won't place any harm on you. Fare well.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 萊比奧迪爾]
只要謹慎行事，我就不會傷害你。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Sigh, since it's Commander Lebiordirr's wish, I will cooperate with you...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
唉，既然萊比奧迪爾指揮官這樣決定，我就協助你...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Ah, you said that there is a strange power blocking the entrance to the Guardian's nest, right?
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
你說，守護者巢穴的入口被一股奇怪的力量擋住了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Please meet with the Guardian and take a wise answer from him. I will trust you.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
去見守護者，向他尋求指點吧。
我相信你。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
... ...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
... ...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Things have actually become like this... as priests of the Guardian, it's our responsibility...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
竟然變成了這樣... 身為守護者的祭司，我們也有責任...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
If we can help you with anything in the future, we will do all we can to assist you. Once again, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
今後若有需要，我們一定盡力相助。
再次感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
AmanVilShar Ie DorLuShar Mu Re
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
AmanVilShar Ie DorLuShar Mu Re

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
You want to go there to find out exactly what that place is?
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
你想去查清那個地方究竟是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Alright...it's as you have assumed, a place connecting to the World Tree. It's also the Guardian's Nest.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
正如你猜的，那裡與天地樹相連，也是守護者的巢穴。

scripts.text: Guardian's Nest?
scripts.translation: 守護者的巢穴

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Yes, that's the nest of Nidhoggur, the Guardian of the World Tree...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
沒錯，是天地樹守護者尼德霍格的巢穴...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Only a marked guardian's servant from the Laphine tribe is allowed to enter.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
只有拉菲尼族中帶有印記的守護者僕從，才獲准進入。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
That place was initially closed off from the public, but then the giants of the Sapha tribe turned things around...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
那裡原本不對外開放，直到薩法族的巨人改變了這一切...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
To obtain more minerals, they started to dig with madness.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
為了獲得更多礦石，他們瘋狂挖掘。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
In the end, they have harmed a part of the World Tree's root that lies very close to their mine, and thus, the World Tree became very ill.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
最後，損傷了礦坑附近的天地樹樹根，讓天地樹病得很重。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
After we have arrived here knowing the facts, the World Tree was already in a very bad state due to the many factories built by the Sapha tribe.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
等我們得知情況趕來時，薩法族已經建起許多工廠，天地樹的狀況極其糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Even though, for a long time, we have been attacking the Sapha tribe, trying to force them to leave, they are not so easily defeated, leading to this stalemate.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
我們長期進攻薩法族，想把他們趕走，可他們並不容易對付，雙方因此陷入僵局。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
During this time, your people have travelled through the space-time gap to this land.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
就在這時，你們穿過時空裂隙，來到了這片土地。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Because of those many unexpected reasons, the Guardian's nest, which was meant to stay hidden deep underground, has been discovered by your race...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
種種意外之下，原本深藏地下的守護者巢穴，竟被你們發現了...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Now you understand how serious this situation is. Because of the Sapha tribe, we are no longer able to approach the Guardian, and seek his teachings of wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
現在明白事情有多嚴重了吧。
因為薩法族，我們無法接近守護者，向他尋求指點。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
It's very insulting to our pride... but if you can help us enter that place again, and speak to the Guardian, maybe we can find a solution...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
這讓我們的尊嚴大受打擊...
但若你能幫我們再次進入，與守護者交談，也許就能找到解決辦法...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Then we'll leave it to you. As for your request, I will do my best to cooperate.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
那就交給你了，你的請求，我也會盡力配合。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
I have already told you what you wanted to know... If you need anything else, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
想知道的事，我都告訴你了...
還有需要，就來找我。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
That's because only the ones chosen by the Guardian may enter.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
只有守護者選中的人，才能進入。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
We have been the Guardian's servants for generations, and have been protecting the World Tree ever since.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
我們世代侍奉守護者，一直守護著天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Before we were captured and brought here, there were 3 servants including me. Our task was to heal the World Tree.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
被俘並帶到這裡之前，算上我，共有三名僕從。
我們的任務是治癒天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
One was killed in our last war with the Sapha tribe... and the other has been taken captive.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
一人在上次與薩法族的戰鬥中陣亡... 另一人被俘了。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
I will give you my proof. Don't worry, I'm just temporarily marking you as a guardian's servant.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
我把自己的憑證交給你。
放心，只是暫時賦予你守護者僕從的印記。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Also, remember this spell, it's needed to open the gate of the Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
還有，記住這段咒語，開啟守護者之門時要用。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
AnomarDu Ha OdesUdenVer Ie
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
AnomarDu Ha OdesUdenVer Ie

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
remuAlaAsh Mu ModtasAn Yu Dur
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
remuAlaAsh Mu ModtasAn Yu Dur

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
TalsehrDur So CyaReMush Di DielAlaWos Ie RuffserIman Ie
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
TalsehrDur So CyaReMush Di DielAlaWos Ie RuffserIman Ie

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Go find the fairy guarding the gate, and say this spell.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
去找守門的妖精，念出這段咒語。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
The proof and the spell will confirm that you are one of the Guardian's servants.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
憑證與咒語能證明你是守護者的僕從。

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
Please meet the Guardian, and come back with an answer to everything. I believe in you.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
去見守護者，帶回這些問題的答案吧。
我相信你。

scripts.text: Not even caring about this a single bit? What a stupid woman...
scripts.translation: 竟然對此毫不在意嗎？真是個愚蠢的女人...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
I represent the entire Laphine tribe, and show you our gratitude. This must all be very hard for our commander...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
我代表整個拉菲尼族向你致謝。
這件事對指揮官而言，一定很難接受...

scripts.text:
[Aide Arioss]
It can't compare with the effort you have put in for us... but please accept our token of friendship.
[Aide Arioss]
If we can help you with anything in the future, we will do all we can to assist you. Once again, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿利奧斯]
這點東西無法報答你付出的努力... 但請收下我們的友誼信物。
[副官 阿利奧斯]
今後若有需要，我們一定盡力相助。
再次感謝你。

scripts.text: Never give attention to... um... a blunt woman...
scripts.translation: 千萬別去理會...呃...那個粗魯的女人...

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
That man is currently under arrest.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
那名男子目前已被逮捕。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
You'd better behave, Aide Arioss says that different races shall be treated the same way.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
最好安分些。
阿利奧斯副官說過，不同種族應當一視同仁。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
This is the Splendide office. Don't act impolitely.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
這裡是輝煌領域的辦公室。請不要無禮。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
This is the Splendide office. Don't act impolitely.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
這裡是輝煌領域的辦公室。請不要無禮。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Guest from the other world, please excuse our rudeness...
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
來自異世界的客人，請原諒我們的無禮...

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
That captive is the only reference for our tribe, so we have taken good care of her. She is related to your current investigation.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
那名俘虜是我族唯一的情報來源，所以我們一直善待她。
她與你正在進行的調查有關。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Recently, because you do not understand the current situations, you have done some things that I, as a leader, can't ignore any longer.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
你不瞭解眼下的局勢，最近做了一些事。
身為首領，我已無法再置之不理。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Do you need me for something, strange one?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
外來者，找我有事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Strange one, we hope our cooperation will be a good one. Now please go interrogate the Laphine prisoner.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
外來者，希望我們合作順利。
現在去詢問那名拉菲尼族俘虜吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Outsider. Welcome to Manuk, the village of the Sapha. I am its representative, Neat Etorr.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
外來者，歡迎來到薩法族的馬努克村。
我是這裡的代表，尼特·艾托爾。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
I was waiting for you. It's good that you're safe. Did you find anything?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
一直在等你。
平安回來就好，有什麼發現？

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Strange one, thank you for helping us in the time of need. I will never forget your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
外來者，謝謝你在我們需要時伸出援手。
這份恩情，我不會忘記。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Outsider. Welcome to the Manuk village of Sapha. I am its representative, Neat Etorr.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
外來者，歡迎來到薩法族的馬努克村。
我是這裡的代表，尼特·艾托爾。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Tkeh likek Ohek QekhlHkl PkedlioH.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
Tkeh likek Ohek QekhlHkl PkedlioH.

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
As the leader of the Sapha tribe, I have something very important to tell you. That is why I asked for you...
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
身為薩法族的首領，有件重要的事必須告訴你。
所以才請你來...

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Your race has come to this land not long ago through the space-time gap.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
不久前，你們穿過時空裂隙，來到這片土地。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
You should have already seen what is going on. We have been at war with the Laphine tribe for a very long time.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
這裡的局勢，你應該也看到了。
我們與拉菲尼族已交戰多年。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Recently, because you do not understand the current situations, you have done some things that I, as a leader, can't ignore any longer.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
你不瞭解眼下的局勢，最近做了一些事。
身為首領，我已無法再置之不理。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
I hope that your people will becareful of your actions on this land, and terminate any unnecessary interventions.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
希望你們在這裡謹慎行事，停止不必要的干預。

scripts.text: Leave quietly.
scripts.translation: 悄悄離開

scripts.text: Don't know what he's talking about, and ask for details.
scripts.translation: 詢問詳情

scripts.text:
[Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
Are we really just letting these people go after they have stirred up problems on our land?
scripts.translation:
[馬努克野外精銳士兵]
在我們的土地上惹出麻煩，就這麼放他們走？

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
After what happened, I don't think they know what else they can do. Let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
事情發展到這一步，他們恐怕也不知道該做什麼。
我來解釋吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
For now, we have acknowledged your race, and have been tolerant towards your activities.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
我們認可你們這一族，也一直容許你們在此活動。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
But we have recently started to suspect you of being the Laphine tribe's eyes and ears.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
但最近，我們懷疑你們是拉菲尼族的耳目。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Not long ago, We have heard that you have found remains in an abandoned cave in the north, and have been conducting investigations and researches regarding it.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
聽說你們最近在北邊的廢棄洞穴發現了遺蹟，正對此展開調查研究。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
We have captured a Laphine tribe priest during the last war, and we have heard that you have had contact with said captive.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
上次交戰，我們俘虜了一名拉菲尼族祭司。
聽說你們接觸過她。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
That captive is the only reference for our tribe, so we have taken good care of her. She is related to your current investigation.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
那名俘虜是我族唯一的情報來源，所以我們一直善待她。
她與你正在進行的調查有關。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
For your people, who have no direct connections, it is not a place satisfy your curiosity. I hope that you stop your investigations, and mind your own business.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
你們與此事並無直接關聯，那裡也不是供你們滿足好奇心的地方。
請停止調查，管好自己的事。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
If you don't accept our request, then do not expect any cooperations between our races in the future.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
若不接受這個要求，就別指望兩族今後還能合作。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Because of the war against the Laphine tribe, everything is a mess. But even then, we cannot allow a foreign race to interfere.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
與拉菲尼族的戰爭讓一切亂成一團。
即便如此，也不能任由外族干涉。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
You have heard it all, now please report back to your race.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
該說的都說了，回去轉告你的族人吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
For your people, who have no direct connections, it is not a place to satisfy your curiosity. I hope that you stop your investigations, and mind your own business.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
你們與此事並無直接關聯，那裡也不是供你們滿足好奇心的地方。
請停止調查，管好自己的事。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
If you don't accept our request, then do not expect any cooperations between our races in the future.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
若不接受這個要求，就別指望兩族今後還能合作。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
I hope that your people will becareful of your actions on this land, and terminate any unnecessary interventions.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
希望你們在這裡謹慎行事，停止不必要的干預。

scripts.text: Received invitation from the Sapha tribe to cooperate and investigate.
scripts.translation: 向薩法族提出合作調查

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Cooperate and investigate? What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
合作進行調查？你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
It seems like you did not understand what I said. What are you thinking?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
看來你沒聽懂我的話。
到底想做什麼？

scripts.text: Please allow me to investigate the cave.
scripts.translation: 請允許我調查那個洞穴

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
From what I can tell, you are disrespecting my request. Is this your intention, or your people's intention?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
這是要無視我的要求？
是你個人的意思，還是你們全族的意思？

scripts.text: It's our intention.
scripts.translation: 這是我們的共同意願

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Ah, it is not an easy decision. You frighten me.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
啊，這可不是輕易能做出的決定。
你們真讓我吃驚。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
But may I ask why you want to do this?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
不過，能告訴我為什麼一定要這樣做嗎？

scripts.text: Explain Professor Magnifier's theory.
scripts.translation: 說明馬格尼弗教授的理論

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
It's surprising that you are able to obtain such results. We also have a similar theory.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
能得出這樣的結論，真令人驚訝。
我們也有類似的推測。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
At least we also think that we must use the Laphine prisoner to get information.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
至少，我們也認為必須從那名拉菲尼族俘虜那裡獲得情報。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
This problem has been the root of our conflicts with the Laphine tribe. Of course, it may also be an opportunity to resolve them.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
這個問題是我們與拉菲尼族衝突的根源。
當然，也可能成為化解衝突的契機。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Therefore, it's more of a reason to depend on our own powers. There is no room for you to interfere. Please give up.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
正因如此，更該靠我們自己解決。
沒有你們插手的餘地，放棄吧。

scripts.text: Give up request, and ask Laphine tribe for help instead.
scripts.translation: 轉而向拉菲尼族求助

scripts.text:
[Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
You finally showed your true face. I knew you were a spy from the Laphine tribe!
scripts.translation:
[馬努克野外精銳士兵]
終於露出真面目了！
我就知道你是拉菲尼族的間諜！

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Ah...you'd go as far as saying that. What good will it do for you, helping the Laphine tribe?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
啊... 竟然把話說到這份上。
幫拉菲尼族，對你有什麼好處？

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Those obnoxious dwarves offended our right of living, and are trying to get rid of us.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
那些討厭的矮人侵犯我們的生存權，還想把我們趕盡殺絕。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
The reason we don't allow anyone to enter that site is because it's full of suspicions.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
我們不許人進去，正是因為那裡疑點重重。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Alright, I'll approve of your request, and let you investigate the secret the Laphine tribe has hidden inside the cave.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
好，我同意你的請求。
去查清拉菲尼族藏在洞穴裡的秘密吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
If you promise to share all of your research results and findings, we will accept your request.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
只要承諾把所有研究結果和發現告訴我們，就准許你調查。

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Alright, from now on, we will cooperate with you, and allow you to directly communicate with the Laphine prisoner.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
好，從現在起，我們與你合作。
你可以直接與那名拉菲尼族俘虜交談。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
Commander...are you sure of this? We don't even know if they're friend or foe...
scripts.translation:
[馬努克野外精銳士兵]
指揮官... 您確定嗎？
他們是敵是友，我們還不知道...

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
With just our powers, it's impossible to figure out what the Laphine is up to. I think the past has proven that.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
僅憑我們，弄不清拉菲尼族的意圖。
過去的經歷已經證明了。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
What they're doing right now could potentially lead us to a solution.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
他們的調查，或許能幫我們找到解決辦法。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Strange one, we hope our cooperation will be a good one. Now please go interrogate the Laphine prisoner.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
外來者，希望我們合作順利。
現在去詢問那名拉菲尼族俘虜吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
We are just a small village, nothing special... but rest comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
村子雖小，也沒什麼特別的... 但請安心休息。

scripts.text: Explain the sudden leave of the Guardian.
scripts.translation: 說明守護者突然離去的事

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
So... that's the nest of the Guardian of the World Tree, the sacred grounds for the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
原來... 那裡是天地樹守護者的巢穴，也是拉菲尼族的聖地。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
But because of the angry leave of the Guardian, his shadow is wreaking havoc on the World Tree?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
守護者憤然離去後，他的影子正在破壞天地樹？

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
If what you're saying is true, then there is no more reason for us to continue fighting the Laphine tribe...
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
若你說的屬實，我們就沒有理由繼續與拉菲尼族交戰了...

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
What a huge discovery... So Nidhoggur is no longer the Guardian of the World Tree...?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
多麼重大的發現...
這麼說，尼德霍格已不再是天地樹的守護者...？

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Nidhoggur's Shadow came to exist in this world, and harmed the roots of the World Tree... what a disaster.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
尼德霍格的影子出現在世間，破壞天地樹的根...
真是一場災難。

scripts.text: Pass along the World Tree Yggdrasil's message.
scripts.translation: 傳達天地樹的話

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Is that what the priest of the Guardian said?
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
守護者的祭司是這麼說的？

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
From now on, we need to talk about this with the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
接下來，得與拉菲尼族商量這件事。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
But of course...we don't know if they're reasonable enough...hehe.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
不過... 還不知道他們講不講道理呢... 呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
This is all we needed from you...What is left is business between us and the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
你的任務完成了...
剩下是我們與拉菲尼族之間的事。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
Thank you for helping us with such a huge problem. You may forget about it now.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
謝謝你幫忙解決這麼大的問題。
這件事，你不必再操心了。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
It's not a lot, but please this as a token of our appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
禮物雖薄，請收下我們的一點謝意。

scripts.text:
[Neat Etorr]
We are just a small village, nothing special... but rest comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[尼特·艾托爾]
村子雖小，也沒什麼特別的... 但請安心休息。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Guard]
I'm guarding this Laphine prisoner. Leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[馬努克衛兵]
我在看守拉菲尼族俘虜，別打擾。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Guard]
Klekod Oi Thekd Pheid Okei.
scripts.translation:
[馬努克衛兵]
Klekod Oi Thekd Pheid Okei.

scripts.text:
[Manuk Guard]
I'm guarding this Laphine prisoner. Leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[馬努克衛兵]
我在看守拉菲尼族俘虜，別打擾。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Guard]
Liek QUekdk Ohei Vue.
scripts.translation:
[馬努克衛兵]
Liek QUekdk Ohei Vue.

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
You... are not of the Sapha tribe... Are you... an outsider?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
你... 不是薩法族的人... 是外來者？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
The sapha tribe went as far as cooperating with an unknown race?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
薩法族居然與來歷不明的種族合作了？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Ah, you said that there is a strange power blocking the entrance to the Guardian's nest, right?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
你說，守護者巢穴的入口被奇怪的力量擋住了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
... ...

[Laphine Prisoner]
Please meet the Guardian, and come back with an answer to everything. And tell the answer to...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
去見守護者，帶回這些問題的答案吧。
然後告訴...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Yes...I heard your conversation with the Sapha tribe...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
嗯... 我聽到了你和薩法族的對話...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
AmanVilShar Ie DorLuShar Mu Re
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
AmanVilShar Ie DorLuShar Mu Re

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Have you ever come in contact with the Laphine tribe? Have you ever been to Splendide?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
你接觸過拉菲尼族嗎？去過輝煌領域嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Please, talk to my people in Splendide. They will come to help me.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
請去輝煌領域找我的族人，他們會來救我。

scripts.text: What happened to you?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼了

scripts.text: What's in the cave to the north?
scripts.translation: 北邊洞穴裡有什麼

scripts.text: Tell me about your tribe.
scripts.translation: 說說你們的部族

scripts.text: I will leave you alone.
scripts.translation: 不打擾你了

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
During out last battle with the Sapha tribe... they caught me and took me prisoner.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
上次與薩法族交戰時... 我被他們抓住，成了俘虜。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
The Sapha tribe attacked first. They are destroying the World Tree.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
是薩法族先動手的，他們正在破壞天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
That's why the war started. But I don't want to fight with the Sapha tribe anymore...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
戰爭就是這樣開始的。
可我不想再與薩法族打仗了...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
If it wasn't for that... I wouldn't survive here...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
要不是這樣... 我恐怕無法活到現在...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Please. Bring this news to all of Splendide. Send someone to save me... or they might kill me.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
拜託，把訊息帶回輝煌領域，叫人來救我...
不然，他們可能會殺了我。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
There is...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
那裡有...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
No... I can't tell you... It's the secret of our tribe...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
不... 不能告訴你... 這是我族的秘密...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
I just want to say this...if the Sapha tribe intrude that place, we will never forgive them!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
只能告訴你... 薩法族若敢闖入那裡，我們絕不原諒！

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
The Laphines have protected the Yggdrasil World Tree for generations.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
拉菲尼族世代守護著天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
We live in a... different time, different land... we came for an expedition.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
我們住在... 另一個時空，另一片土地...
是作為遠征隊來到這裡的。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
After we received reports from our spy about the World Tree's strange symptoms, we recgnized the Manuk's existence.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
密探報告了天地樹的異常，我們這才發現馬努克的存在。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
They are mining metal, and in so doing, destroying the World Tree's roots...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
他們開採金屬，破壞了天地樹的根...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
So we dispatched an expedition here. Soonafter, the war with the Sapha began...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
所以我們派了遠征隊過來。
不久後，與薩法族的戰爭就爆發了...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
What is your purpose? Why do you want to know what that place is?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
你有什麼目的？為什麼要打聽那個地方？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
lright...it's as you have assumed, a place connecting to the World Tree. It's also the Guardian's Nest.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
正如你猜的，那裡與天地樹相連，也是守護者的巢穴。

scripts.text: Guardian's Nest?
scripts.translation: 守護者的巢穴

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Yes, that's the nest of Nidhoggur, the Guardian of the World Tree...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
沒錯，是天地樹守護者尼德霍格的巢穴...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Only a marked guardian's servant from the Laphine tribe is allowed to enter.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
只有拉菲尼族中帶有印記的守護者僕從，才獲准進入。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
That place was initially closed off from the public, but then the giants of the Sapha tribe turned things around...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
那裡原本不對外開放，直到薩法族的巨人改變了這一切...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
To obtain more minerals, they started to dig with madness.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
為了獲得更多礦石，他們瘋狂挖掘。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
In the end, they have harmed a part of the World Tree's root that lies very close to their mine, and thus, the World Tree became very ill.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
最後，損傷了礦坑附近的天地樹樹根，讓天地樹病得很重。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
After we have arrived here knowing the facts, the World Tree was already in a very bad state due to the many factories built by the Sapha tribe.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
等我們得知情況趕來時，薩法族已經建起許多工廠，天地樹的狀況極其糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Even though, for a long time, we have been attacking the Sapha tribe, trying to force them to leave, they are not so easily defeated, leading to this stalemate.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
我們長期進攻薩法族，想把他們趕走，可他們並不容易對付，雙方因此陷入僵局。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
During this time, your people have travelled through the space-time gap to this land.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
就在這時，你們穿過時空裂隙，來到了這片土地。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Because of those many unexpected reasons, the Guardian's nest, which was meant to stay hidden deep underground, has been discovered by your race...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
由於種種意外，原本深藏地下的守護者巢穴被你們發現了...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Now you understand how serious this situation is. Because of the Sapha tribe, we are no longer able to approach the Guardian, and seek his teachings of wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
現在明白事情有多嚴重了吧。
因為薩法族，我們無法接近守護者，向他尋求指點。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Hmph...even if I don't cooperate, I know you will find other means to get in...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
哼... 就算不配合，你們也會想別的辦法進去...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Looking at the current situation of the Laphine tribe, we do not have enough power to surround the Manuk fields, and chase the giants away.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
以拉菲尼族目前的力量，無法圍住馬努克地區，把巨人趕走。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Okay, if it has already become like this, I will help you. There are no dead-ends. If you keep going, you will find a solution.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
好吧，事已至此，我幫你。
總有路可走，只要堅持，就能找到辦法。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Even if I don't say anything, my situation will not change.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
就算什麼也不說，我的處境也不會好轉。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
I have already told you everything you wanted to hear. If you have any other requests, please let me know.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
想知道的，我都告訴你了。
還有需要，就來找我。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
That's because only the ones chosen by the Guardian may enter.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
只有守護者選中的人，才能進入。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
We have been the Guardian's servants for generations, and have been protecting the World Tree ever since.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
我們世代侍奉守護者，一直守護著天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Before we were captured and brought here, there were 3 servants including me. Our task was to heal the World Tree.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
被俘並帶到這裡之前，算上我，共有三名僕從。
我們的任務是治癒天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
One was killed in our last war with the Sapha tribe...and I have been taken captive.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
一人在上次與薩法族的戰鬥中陣亡... 而我被俘了。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
I will give you my proof. Don't worry, I'm just temporarily marking you as a guardian's servant.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
我把自己的憑證交給你。
放心，只是暫時賦予你守護者僕從的印記。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Also, remember this spell, it's needed to open the gate of the Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
還有，記住這段咒語，開啟守護者之門時要用。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
AnomarDu Ha OdesUdenVer Ie
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
AnomarDu Ha OdesUdenVer Ie

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
remuAlaAsh Mu ModtasAn Yu Dur
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
remuAlaAsh Mu ModtasAn Yu Dur

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
TalsehrDur So CyaReMush Di DielAlaWos Ie RuffserIman Ie
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
TalsehrDur So CyaReMush Di DielAlaWos Ie RuffserIman Ie

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Go find the fairy guarding the gate, and say this spell.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
去找守門的妖精，念出這段咒語。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
he proof and the spell will confirm that you are one of the Guardian's servants.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
憑證與咒語能證明你是守護者的僕從。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Please meet the Guardian, and come back with an answer to everything. And tell the answer to...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
去見守護者，帶回這些問題的答案吧。
然後告訴...

scripts.text:
[Manuk Guard]
Hey, outsider! Step away from the prisoner!
scripts.translation:
[馬努克衛兵]
喂，外來者！離俘虜遠點！

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
If our tribe were to really trust in the Sapha tribe...I don't know.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
我族若真的相信薩法族... 我也不知道...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Our hatred towards them has already reached an abnormal level...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
我們對他們的仇恨，已經深得不正常了...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
Those giants...can they really be trusted?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
那些巨人...真的可以信任嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Prisoner]
It's...it's better if you don't believe the one called Etorr...the minds of the Sapha tribe is unpredictable.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼囚犯]
最好... 別相信那個叫艾托爾的人...
薩法族的心思，誰也猜不透。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Guard]
Hey, outsider! Step away from the prisoner!
scripts.translation:
[馬努克衛兵]
喂，外來者！離俘虜遠點！

scripts.text:
[Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
This is Neat Etorr's order. Please come with us to see him.
scripts.translation:
[馬努克野外精銳士兵]
尼特·艾托爾有令，跟我們去見他。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
Bring him to Neat Etorr. All soldiers be prepared.
scripts.translation:
[馬努克野外精銳士兵]
把他帶去見尼特·艾托爾。
全體士兵，準備！

scripts.text: When a faint light enters your heart, a voice sounds in your head.
scripts.translation: 微光融入你的心中，一個聲音在腦海裡響起。

scripts.text:
[World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
It's all over... servants of the Guardian... Hurry up and leave this place.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
結束了... 守護者的僕從們... 快離開這裡。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 什麼意思

scripts.text:
[World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
I... I am the World Tree Yggdrasil, servant of the Guardian of Nidhoggur, as well as the High Priest leading the Laphine Tribe.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
我... 我是天地樹，守護者尼德霍格的僕從，也是領導拉菲尼族的大祭司。

scripts.text:
[World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
So you're not priestess of the Laphine Tribe... How did you get in? No, there's no time to answer that.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
你不是拉菲尼族的女祭司... 怎麼進來的？
不，沒時間問這些了。

scripts.text:
[World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
Hurry... and leave... leave this place before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
快... 離開... 趁還來得及，離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
The guardian... something's wrong with the guardian. I don't know what made him like this.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
守護者... 他出了問題。
我不知道為什麼會變成這樣。

scripts.text:
[World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
This... this is no longer the nest of the Guardian of the World Tree Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
這裡... 已不再是天地樹守護者的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Darkness took over the Guardian and destroyed all living things... now this place has become the cursed home of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
黑暗控制了守護者，毀滅所有生靈...
如今，這裡已是受詛咒的魔物巢穴。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Now the vile Nidhoggur's Shadow is wreaking havoc here...
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
邪惡的尼德霍格之影，正在這裡肆虐...

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Now's not too late, hurry and get out... tell the Laphine Tribe about this... tell the commanders of Alfheim...
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
還來得及，快逃出去...
把這件事告訴拉菲尼族，告訴阿爾弗雷姆的指揮官們...

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
My soul... it has been trapped here. You're the only ones I can trust now.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
我的靈魂... 被困在這裡。
如今只能相信你們了。

scripts.text: Nidhoggur's Shadow?
scripts.translation: 尼德霍格的影子

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The Guardian Nidhoggur... he's not in the nest.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
守護者尼德霍格... 已經不在巢穴裡。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
He...for some reason abandoned his own shadow, and left.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
不知為什麼... 他拋下自己的影子，離開了。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
All that's left, is the ugly Shadow of the Guardian of Nidhoggur...the Shadow that is going mad.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
只剩下尼德霍格那醜陋的影子... 已經發狂的影子。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The Shadow sucked all the nutrients from the World Tree Yggdrasil, and has gone mad when there is nothing more left to obtain. Now, he wants this land.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
影子吸盡天地樹的養分，無可汲取後便陷入瘋狂。
現在，它又盯上了這片土地。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Once the ugly Shadow leaves here to steal power from the other World Yggdrasil Trees, there will be great destruction. This world will become hell.
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
若這醜陋的影子離開這裡，去奪取其他天地樹的力量，將造成巨大的災難。
世界會變成地獄。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
You must... tell the commanders of Alfheim about this, and come up with a plan. Only them...
scripts.translation:
[天地樹]
必須... 告訴阿爾弗雷姆的指揮官們，讓他們想辦法。
只有他們...
